1.narrative: My name is Robert Harrington, I'm calling about policy number POL-2024-10021. Yesterday, October 5th 2024, at around 2:30 PM, I was involved in a collision at the intersection of Maple Street and 4th Avenue in Springfield. I was driving my 2021 Honda Civic when a blue Ford F-150 ran the red light and struck my front bumper and driver-side door. The other driver's name is Marcus Webb and he was driving a 2019 Ford F-150, license plate MRC-4821. His insurance is Safe Harbor Auto, policy SH-88210. There are no injuries — both of us walked away fine. The police were called and the report number is SPD-2024-9934. My car was towed by City Towing. I have three photos of the damage.

2.narrative: This is Priya Nair, policyholder on POL-2024-20034. On September 28th, 2024 at approximately 9:15 in the morning, I was rear-ended on Highway 101 near Exit 42 in Riverside. I drive a 2020 Toyota Camry. The vehicle that hit me was a silver Nissan Altima driven by Daniel Okafor — I have his insurance details: Liberty Shield Auto, policy number LB-55021. My rear bumper is severely damaged and the trunk won't close. No injuries, but my neck is a bit stiff. I've already been to urgent care. Police responded and gave me report number RVD-2024-4421. The car was not towed — I drove it home.

3.narrative: Hi, I'm Carlos Mendez reporting a claim on policy POL-2024-30087. The accident happened on October 1st 2024 at 7:45 PM at the corner of Oak Drive and Commerce Boulevard in Lakeview. I was driving my 2022 Chevrolet Malibu when a white SUV swerved into my lane and sideswiped my driver-side door and fender. The other driver is Amanda Fitch, she drives a 2021 Jeep Grand Cherokee, insured with National Protect, policy NP-30021. One passenger in my car had a cut on her arm and was taken by ambulance. Police report is LVP-2024-7821. My car was towed by Lakeside Recovery.

4.narrative: Sandra Bloom here, policy POL-2024-40055. I was in an accident on September 29th 2024 on Birch Lane near the shopping plaza in Westfield. My 2019 Hyundai Elantra got hit in the rear. No injuries. The other driver left without giving me their information. I did not call the police. My car is driveable.

5.narrative: This is Michael Torres, policy POL-2024-50066. Accident on October 4th 2024 at 11AM at Pine Avenue and Route 5 in Oakdale. I drive a 2020 Kia Sorento. The other car, a grey Honda Accord, ran a stop sign and hit my passenger side. The other driver is Jennifer Hale. No injuries. No police. No tow. I don't have her insurance information.

6.narrative: I need to report a claim. I was in a really bad crash. It happened sometime last week — I think Tuesday or Wednesday — on the highway near my house. My windshield shattered and the right side of the car is completely caved in. I'm still at the hospital. My policy is POL-2024-60077. The other vehicle was a truck of some kind. I don't remember much else.

7.narrative: James Okoye, policy POL-2024-70044. The accident was on March 15th 2024 at 6:30 PM at the corner of Pine Street and 9th in Millbrook. I drive a 2019 Ford Fusion. The other driver, Kevin Shah, drives a red 2018 Toyota Corolla. His insurance company is Apex Auto but I didn't get the policy number. The damage is mostly cosmetic — scratches along my rear quarter panel and the rear bumper. No injuries, no police. The car is driveable.

8.narrative: I had an accident. My car is damaged. I need to file a claim.

9.narrative: Policy number POL-2024-90011. Car crash yesterday on the interstate. Need to report it.

10.narrative: Hi this is Dana Kim, my policy is POL-2024-10055. Someone hit my parked car in front of my house overnight. I woke up this morning to find the driver-side mirror broken off and a long scratch down the door. I have no idea who did it.

11.narrative: I'm calling on behalf of my husband Gregory Walsh. His policy number is POL-2024-11030. I'm Linda Walsh, his wife. The accident happened on October 3rd 2024 at about 4PM on Route 9 near the Riverside Bridge in Greenfield. Gregory was driving our 2023 Kia Telluride and was hit from behind by a delivery van. The driver of the van is Brian Doyle, employed by Swift Freight. The van's licence plate is SWF-9921 and Brian said the company insures through Commercial Guard, policy CG-444210. Gregory has whiplash and is being treated at Greenfield General. The police came and gave us report number GFD-2024-6631. The Telluride is at Premier Towing.

12.narrative: Fatima Al-Hassan, policy POL-2024-12041. Accident on September 30th 2024 at 8:20 AM at the junction of Cedar Road and Highway 7 in Eastbrook. I drive a 2018 Mazda CX-5. A pickup truck driven by Derek Summers ran a red light and struck my front bumper. He's insured with Horizon Auto, policy HA-91003. No injuries on either side. Police came, report is EBP-2024-3322. My car couldn't be driven so it was towed by Eastbrook Auto Rescue.

13.narrative: I'm Victor Crane, policy POL-2024-13052. On October 2nd 2024 at noon, I was stopped at a red light on Grant Avenue and 5th Street in Brookside when a blue Hyundai rear-ended me. I had the green light so I entered the intersection normally — then the Hyundai hit me from behind. The other driver is Steve Bates, insured with Cardinal Shield, policy CS-20019. His 2022 Hyundai Elantra hit my rear bumper. No injuries. Police report is BRK-2024-5541. No tow needed.

14.narrative: I'm Nora Fleming, POL-2024-14063. The accident was on September 25th 2024 around 3PM on Willow Creek Road, Harborton. I drive a 2020 Volkswagen Golf. The other driver is Max Stanton in a grey 2019 BMW 3 Series, insured with BlueLine Auto, BL-77041. He rear-ended me — I was stationary. My rear bumper and tailgate are damaged. No injuries. Police report is HBT-2024-8802. My car is fine to drive. No tow needed. Oh, and I should mention my front hood also has a large dent — it happened in the same accident.

15.narrative: Harry Nguyen, policy POL-2024-15074. There was a collision on August 18th 2024, around 7 in the evening, on Sunset Boulevard near the old cinema. My car is a 2017 Nissan Altima. The other driver, Cathy Mercer, was completely stopped when I hit her. I was not at fault — she swerved into my lane without signaling. My front bumper is damaged. No police, no tow needed. I don't believe anyone was injured.

16.narrative: Angela Torres, policy POL-2024-16085. October 4th 2024, 2PM, on Market Street and 3rd, Pineville. I was driving my 2021 Ford Escape. The other vehicle, driven by Marcus Bell, sideswiped my driver-side door. His car is a 2020 Chevy Impala, insured with Summit Auto, SUM-30045. Nobody was injured. Police report is PVD-2024-7712. No tow. I should also mention the accident happened at night — it was really dark which is why I didn't see him coming.

17.narrative: Samuel Reed, policy POL-2024-17096. October 2nd 2024, 11:30 AM, at Elm Avenue and Route 14, Clayton. I drive a 2022 Hyundai Tucson. Another car, driven by Claire Barnes, ran the stop sign and hit my rear bumper. Claire's car is a 2021 Ford Focus, insured with Fairway Auto, FA-60031. I have a minor bruise on my arm. Police report is CLD-2024-4412. My car was towed by Clayton Towing.

18.narrative: This is Rachel Obi, policy POL-2024-18007. The accident was September 27th 2024 at 5:30 PM on the corner of Valley Road and Commerce Street, Norford. I drive a 2020 Mazda 3. The other driver hit my windshield — something flew off their truck and cracked it. The other driver pulled over and gave me his info: Roy Kaplan, 2018 RAM 1500, insured with Pioneer Auto PA-54321. No injuries. No police. No tow.

19.narrative: Ben Calloway here, policy POL-2024-19018. This happened on October 3rd 2024 at around 10:45 PM in the parking lot of Riverside Shopping Center in Clearmont. I was walking back to my 2019 Jeep Wrangler after grocery shopping and found it had been hit. There was significant damage to the rear quarter panel and the taillight is shattered. The other vehicle fled — I have no information on them. A witness gave me her name: Linda Fox, phone 555-0192. I called the police and they took a report: CLM-2024-9921. My car was not towed — I drove it home. No personal injuries.

20.narrative: Sheila Montgomery, policy POL-2024-20029. Chain-reaction collision on the I-78 on September 26th 2024 at 8:10 AM near mile marker 44, Langton. I drive a 2023 Toyota RAV4. I was struck from the rear by a silver Dodge Ram driven by Patrick Ellis, pushing me into the car in front — a 2020 Kia Sorento driven by Wendy Chu. Patrick's insurance is Coastal Auto, CA-71120. Wendy's insurance is TrustLine, TL-30041. My rear bumper and front hood are both damaged. Patrick's ram caused all impact, Wendy is the vehicle I hit secondarily. No personal injuries to me, but Wendy reported back pain at the scene. Police report is LGT-2024-6601. My car was towed by Highway Assist.
